agentkitPattern: createAgentkitHooks.requestHook returns { grantAccess: true }; wire via http.onProtectedRequest (or transportHooks.http.onProtectedRequest). Missing header is void → 402, not skip-on-verify.
planCorrection: Do not use onBeforeVerify { skip: true } for the free tier. AgentKit free mode never enters verify/settle. Warrant: valid+under-quota → grantAccess; valid+exhausted → void (402/pay); revoked/invalid → abort 403; missing header → void so the client sees 402 with extensions.warrant.
